title: Find out whether boxes and ovals Ask draws land half a line too small
goal: When an SVG holding an outlined box or oval was read into layers, its line sat inside the box, so the shape came out half a line too small and lines meant to meet it stuck out. Opening a file now puts the line where the file says; Ask reads SVG through the same reader and may still have the fault, which would show on any outline icon it draws. Find out, and fix it if so.
notes: Not reproduced through Ask itself, hence p2 and a question. Seen through SVGArtwork.layers, which Ask also uses: lucide mail.svg scored 53.08 of 255 mean difference from macOS's drawing with the line inside the box and left the worst of the list once SVGOpening set style.borderPosition = .center. Ask's path was left alone on purpose: its grid landing and tests are pinned to today's numbers.
acceptance: An Ask drawing of an outlined box is compared with the SVG the model wrote, and the log says whether the box moved
If it did, the box lands where the SVG says, and the eval's climb and held-out totals are both reported

log.note: owns no walks; the ones it names are examples

Compared the model's own SVG with what Ask made, same case before and after: ticked-box eval case, model wrote <rect x=3 y=3 width=18 height=18 rx=4> at stroke-width 2 both times. Run 20261108-235558-ask (before 5ced1498a, 2026-11-09 00:08) exported it at 4,4 16x16 rx 3: the box DID move, half a line small all round. Run 20261112-105732-ask exports 3,3 18x18 rx 4 with the line on the edge, exactly as written. Ovals: recent runs land model circles r 1.5 to 2 after grid rounding, never the r 0.5 an inside line would give. Already fixed by 5ced1498a (SVGArtwork.layers sets strokePosition and borderPosition to .center), which every Ask route uses (addDrawing -> iconFrame or group). Added AskIconTests 'A box and an oval Ask draws on an icon's grid land where the model's SVG put them': through addDrawing, with and without onGrid, box at 3,3 18x18 corner 4 and oval at 8,8 8x8, both centred. It fails with the line put back inside. Eval (Scripts/ask-eval.sh report): climb 57.5 (6 cases, 20261112-105732-ask), held-out 54.9 (53 cases, 20261110-083155-ask-held-out), both run after the fix; no lookups.

Yes, they did, and it is already fixed: the same model SVG box (3,3 18x18 rx 4, line 2) landed at 4,4 16x16 rx 3 before 5ced1498a (run 20261108-235558-ask) and lands exactly as written since (run 20261112-105732-ask). Pinned through Ask's addDrawing, on and off the icon grid, in AskIconTests (6763c0ea2); it fails with the line put back inside. Climb 57.5, held-out 54.9, both run after the fix. Scripts/test.sh green.
